query:
SELECT 
  empresaSlug,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (cat1 + cat2 + cat3 + cat4 + cat5 + cat6 + cat7 + cat8) > 0 THEN data END) as dias_com_faturamento_real,
  SUM(CASE WHEN (cat1 + cat2 + cat3 + cat4 + cat5 + cat6 + cat7 + cat8) > 0 THEN (cat1 + cat2 + cat3 + cat4 + cat5 + cat6 + cat7 + cat8) ELSE 0 END) as total_com_faturamento_real,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN (cat1 + cat2 + cat3 + cat4 + cat5 + cat6 + cat7 + cat8) > 0 THEN (cat1 + cat2 + cat3 + cat4 + cat5 + cat6 + cat7 + cat8) ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (cat1 + cat2 + cat3 + cat4 + cat5 + cat6 + cat7 + cat8) > 0 THEN data END), 2) as media_diaria_real
FROM faturamentos 
WHERE data >= '2026-05-01' AND data <= '2026-05-28'
GROUP BY empresaSlug
ORDER BY empresaSlug;
